infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone records how a word is said (a name, a word in dialect) and lets an adult dictate a sentence to show it on the board. Recordings are kept in the child’s private space in the family’s account, so they also play on the child’s other devices.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition turns what an adult says into words: to find a word by saying it, or to show a dictated sentence on the board.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera takes a photo of a person, an object or a place to add it to the child’s words. Photos are kept in the child’s private space in the family’s account, so they also appear on the child’s other devices. A photo taken to suggest an activity board is only sent once to the AI, and not kept.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photos from the library illustrate the child’s words. They are kept in the child’s private space in the family’s account, so they also appear on the child’s other devices. A photo chosen to suggest an activity board is only sent once to the AI, and not kept.
